meta.style: A calm, clear maths teacher speaking Mandarin Chinese to one secondary-school student. Even pace, no exaggerated emotion. Short natural pause at each comma.

segments.say: 从一加到一百，总和是多少？
把第一个数和最后一个数配成一对，一加一百，二加九十九，三加九十八，每一对的和都是一百零一。
segments.show: Numbers 1 2 3 4 … 97 98 99 100 in a row; arcs pair them one by one

segments.say: 一百个数正好组成五十对，所以总和是五十乘一百零一，等于五千零五十。
